_note: Tower select layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255, except the tower info's two colours, AARRGGBB hex strings. Opacities and shades 0 to 1.

notice._note: The text shown while the song list is not ready.

towers._note: visible_each_side towers on each side of the chosen one. Tower i (0 = chosen) stands at center_x + spacing_x * i, its foot at base_y + |arc_drop * (i + floor(i * arc_factor))|, scaled by 1 - |i / scale_divisor|, its brightness 255 / ((|i| + 1) * fade_factor). art_scale scales the TowerArt pieces; floors_max is the most floors a tower shows. A name sits title_rise pixels over the foot (times the scale); the folder path of a back or random entry under it.

badge._note: The back, random and folder entries: a badge floating lift pixels over its pedestal, on a disc (cream for back, the folder's colour for folders).

info._note: The chosen tower's info box, centred top_offset - y pixels over the tower's foot; the other positions are from the box's top left. digit_spacing is the step between two digits of a number.

confirm._note: The wooden signs of the confirm menu. The title sign's centre lands at (center_x, title_y); each option hangs rope_length under it, option_gap apart, in one of option_slots slots (option_slot names each option's). hole_x / hole_y place a rope's hole from a sign's corner; button_pad keeps wood clear around an option's button. The ropes of the title sign start at rope_top_y. The veil (scaled by veil_scale) dims the screen to veil_opacity; an option not chosen is shaded to unchosen_shade. The question's width is the title sign's minus title_text_inset.
